releases.title: RTX resize fallback, MOSS-Image LoRA installs, a working Snap and LLM names in the Builder

sections.title: Added
items: Added an nvidia-vfx card to the Custom Nodes window. It installs the optional NVIDIA RTX Video Super Resolution library with pip from NVIDIA's index (about 800 MB) without ComfyUI-Manager, and Install Missing Nodes leaves it alone.

sections.title: Improved
items: Labels, tooltips, placeholders and messages in the Video Builder now name the LLM Runner you selected (LM Studio, LLM API, Qwen Local or Custom Server) instead of always saying Gemma. Gemma Local keeps its wording, and the Gemma-only settings, Prompt Creator and the built-in Gemma4 Draft still say Gemma.

The MOSS-Image 8-step Turbo LoRA button in Models > Image Models now installs the file itself, like the Edit LoRA button, and saves it as moss_image_sft_8_steps_dmd_lora.safetensors instead of lora.safetensors.
The Edit LoRA button is now labelled Edit LoRA, and the MOSS-Image folder notes no longer ask you to rename either LoRA file.
Reference card prompts use the neutral route /vrgdg/music_builder/reference_image_prompt. The old flux_reference_zimage_prompt path still works.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Fixed MiniMax H3 2 Pass renders failing at the very last node when nvidia-vfx is not installed. The final resize now falls back from nvidia_rtx_vsr to lanczos, and the console prints the pip command that installs the library.

Fixed Snap in the agent API and the song pipeline (pipeline_from_song): scope all did nothing and still reported that it had snapped, and all_starts put every boundary back where it was. Boundaries within 0.14 s of a beat now move onto it, scenes with a locked video are skipped, an unknown scope is refused, and the answer reports how many scenes moved.

Fixed the full-video and first/last-frame pipelines reading image_path from the image result when approving a scene image. The result holds saved_path, and approval only worked by falling back to the newest image in the history.

sections.title: Compatibility Notes
items: Restart ComfyUI after updating, then hard-refresh the browser so the revised Video Builder JavaScript is loaded.
NVIDIA RTX Video Super Resolution needs an NVIDIA RTX GPU and the nvidia-vfx library. Without it the final resize uses lanczos.
H3 Studio 0.1.28 carries the same changes.

releases.title: ComfyUI's built-in MiniMax H3 latent upscaler

sections.title: Added
items: The Video Builder's learned latent upscale nodes now use the MiniMax H3 latent upscaler that is built into ComfyUI 0.44.0 and newer, so those versions no longer need the Comfyui_Minimax_h3_latent_Upscaler custom node pack. ComfyUI chooses device and precision there, so the loader's device and precision inputs are ignored.
The Custom Nodes window reports your ComfyUI version, shows the upscaler pack as Built in on 0.44.0 and newer, and skips it in Install Missing Nodes.

sections.title: Improved
items: Older ComfyUI is unchanged: the nodes load the pack's backend as before. Without that pack the error now says to update ComfyUI to 0.44.0 or newer, or install the pack.
Saved workflows keep working, because the node inputs and outputs are the same on both paths.

sections.title: Compatibility Notes
items: Restart ComfyUI after updating.
Comfyui-MMH3-UltimateUpscale has no built-in replacement and is still required for 2 Pass Advanced.
The latent-upscaler checkpoint (minimax_h3_latent_upscaler_3d_bf16.safetensors) must be installed separately either way.
H3 Studio 0.1.27 matches: its Custom Nodes window now asks this pack in ComfyUI, so Install and Install Missing Nodes work from the app.

releases.title: Own thumbnail and intro video, Browser AI thumbnails and Auto Build scene presets

sections.title: Added
items: The Thumbnail dialog takes your own picture (png, jpg or webp) and your own intro video. The finished video starts with the thumbnail as its first frame, then your intro video with its own sound, then the video. An intro of another size or frame rate is fitted with black bars, never cropped.
Added Flow, GPT Image and Meta AI (Browser AI) as thumbnail engines, each its own entry in the engine list. They run in your own signed-in Chrome.

sections.title: Improved
items: Auto Build now has synchronized scene presets, with Medium shots as the default.
Multi-shot Whisper timing is now batched before the LLM writes the prompts.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Fixed a misleading Advanced tiling label in the MiniMax render settings.

sections.title: Compatibility Notes
items: Restart ComfyUI after updating, then hard-refresh the browser so the revised Video Builder JavaScript is loaded.
The Browser AI engines need Chrome and your own accounts signed in on each site.
H3 Studio 0.1.26 matches.

releases.title: Thumbnail intro, MOSS-Image models, reference bypass buttons and a Gemma reply fix

sections.title: Added
items: Added a Thumbnail button in the middle of the Builder toolbar. Pick the exact frame of the final video, write the title and prompt (or let the LLM write it from your own brief), and generate it with Qwen Image Edit, NanoBanana, an API image or an Overlay engine that keeps the frame exactly. The video can start with the picture as a one-frame intro.
Added MOSS-Image models and settings to the Image tab model list and the Models dialog, and an Edit LoRA button that installs the LoRA as moss_image_edit_lora.safetensors.
Added the official and Singularity MiniMax H3 diffusion models to the model chooser.
Added bypass buttons for MiniMax reference changes, also in the Render All error dialog.
Added the Euler Flow Matching scheduler node to the Builder's custom nodes list.

sections.title: Improved
items: Auto Build now remembers its inputs in each project when you close it.
Krea 2 reference generation is Krea-only, and the DMAD LoRAs are enforced across the Builder and the agent API.
The Update button now follows the main branch, since Beta2.0 was deleted.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Fixed the Gemma node cutting every reply to one paragraph when keep_all_text is on, which turned Draft Story into a single act.
Fixed Auto Build failing on a missing LLM runner payload helper.
Removed a wrong comfyui-workflow-encrypt package tag from the MiniMax H3 workflows.

sections.title: Compatibility Notes
items: Restart ComfyUI after updating, then hard-refresh the browser so the revised Video Builder JavaScript is loaded.
The MOSS-Image Edit LoRA needs a ComfyUI newer than v0.42.1.
H3 Studio 0.1.25 matches.
